items.title: Fuel return hose permeation
items.summary: Fuel return hose between tank and return line can develop microcracks and seep fuel; dealers replace the hoses. 487 G 55s

items.title: Front turn signals behind grille covers (FMVSS 108)
items.summary: Headlamp/turn-signal grille covers can reduce signal output over time; dealers fit improved turn-signal units

items.title: Passenger airbag molding strip
items.summary: On trucks built Sept 2010–Apr 2011, parts of the molding strip can come loose during passenger airbag deployment

timeline.change: G 55 AMG debuts in Europe with the naturally aspirated 5.4-litre M113, 354 hp
US launch (MY2002) alongside the G 500 as Mercedes-Benz USA takes over from Europa; 349 hp, 722.6 five-speed
Supercharged M113K Kompressor (US MY2005), 469 hp; 500-unit G 500 / G 55 Grand Edition built for the US
Power up to 500 PS (MY2007 in the US); HID headlamps, reversing camera and TPMS arrive for the range. G 55 keeps the 722.6 five-speed
507 PS; three-fin grille, KOMPRESSOR lettering, titanium-grey wheels and 275/55R19 tires
Last US model year for the G 55
Replaced by the biturbo G 63 AMG (MY2013 in the US)

identify.intro: Plenty of G 500s and G 550s wear AMG badges, bumpers and side pipes. The VIN tells you what left Graz.

items.head: VIN characters 4–8
items.body: Bring a Trailer examples decoded with NHTSA's vPIC tool: 2003 G 55 = WDCYR46E…, 2005–2008 G 55 Kompressor = WDCYR71E…, 2011 G 55 = WDCYC7BF…. A same-year G 500 reads WDCYR49E… and a 2010–2014 G 550 WDCYC3HF…, so a 'G 55' with a G 500/G 550 VIN is a dress-up.

items.head: Model year (10th character)
items.body: The 10th character gives the model year (e.g. 3 = 2003, 5 = 2005, 8 = 2008, B = 2011). US G 55s from 2002–2004 are naturally aspirated; 2005–2011 are Kompressors.

items.head: Supercharger and intercooler
items.body: A Kompressor has a supercharger on top of the V8 and an intercooler circuit with its own pump. No supercharger means a 2002–2004 truck or not a G 55.

items.head: 2009-on visual cues
items.body: From 2009, the G 55 has a three-fin grille, KOMPRESSOR lettering under the V8 badge on the front wings and titanium-grey wheels.

items.head: Grand Edition
items.body: The 2005 Grand Edition has Allanite Grey Magno paint, brushed-aluminium trim strips with 'Grand Edition' lettering and illuminated Grand Edition door sills.

capability.note: braked; spec data for a 2005 G 55

capability.v: EPA 12 city / 14 hwy (2003); 11 city / 13 hwy (2005 and 2011 Kompressor)

values.intro: Prices depend mostly on mileage. Low-mile Kompressors and Grand Editions sell for well over twice what a tired driver does.
values.note: Based on 41 Bring a Trailer G 55 sales from January 2025 to October 2026 (median $50,000). The top results were a 1k-mile 2005 at $139,000 and a 2005 Grand Edition at $150,000.
